Total Sales.definition: Signed total of all loaded movements in the current filter context. Reconciliation measure; GBP.

Main Sales.definition: Gross eligible merchandise sales. Product, Normal, quantity and price positive, invoice not cancelled; GBP.

Returns Amount.definition: Magnitude of negative eligible merchandise movements, counted once. Cancellation/reversal proxy, not proof of physical returns; GBP.

Return Value.definition: Compatibility alias for Returns Amount. Same merchandise scope in every visual; GBP.

Net Sales.dax:
VAR Gross = [Main Sales]
VAR Reversals = [Returns Amount]
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(Gross) && ISBLANK(Reversals), BLANK(), COALESCE(Gross, 0) - COALESCE(Reversals, 0))
Net Sales.definition: Gross eligible merchandise sales less merchandise cancellations/reversals. Administrative adjustments and other movements excluded; GBP.

Orders.definition: Distinct invoices with at least one eligible positive merchandise line. Cancellation invoices excluded. Counts are not additive across products/countries.

Unique Customers.definition: Distinct identified customers with eligible merchandise sales in the current context. Anonymous buyers cannot be counted.

Average Order Value.definition: Net merchandise value per eligible sale invoice in the selected period. Reversals are dated at posting, not matched to original orders. Not a physical basket average; GBP.

Return rate.definition: Merchandise cancellation/reversal amount divided by gross eligible merchandise sales in the selected period. Posting-period value ratio, not physical return probability; blank if denominator absent.

Units Sold.definition: Positive eligible merchandise units. Administrative/gift voucher quantities excluded.

Cancelled Orders.definition: Distinct invoices containing eligible negative merchandise movements. All such invoices in this source have prefix C; no claim of physical returns or original-order linkage.

Zero Price Records.definition: Loaded lines with zero unit price. Quality diagnostic across all line types, respecting current filters.

Administrative Adjustments.definition: Signed administrative and special-code movements, including commissions, postage, discounts, manual adjustments, samples and bad debt. Not recognized profit or operating expenses; GBP.

Other Movements.dax: CALCULATE([Total Sales], KEEPFILTERS('Online Retail'[Movement_Type] IN {"Gift voucher movement", "Other / excluded movement"}))
Other Movements.definition: Signed gift voucher and residual excluded movements. Completes the bridge Net Sales + Administrative Adjustments + Other Movements = Total Sales; GBP.

Units Reversed.definition: Magnitude of merchandise units on negative cancellation/reversal lines. Not verified physical returned units.

Unidentified Net Sales.definition: Net merchandise value where customer ID is blank. Included in commercial totals but not identified-customer rankings; GBP.

Identified Sales Share.definition: Share of gross eligible merchandise sales with a known customer ID in the current context. Financial coverage, not share of all buyers.
